messages.text:
Added `docs/design/inputs/DES-003-calorimeter-review-1.md`.

Recommendations:

- Detached forward calorimeter: **|z| = 11.2–13.2 m**, **r = 0.12–1.50 m**.
- Geometric full-depth reach: **2.871 < |eta| < 5.229**; eta 5.2 has only 3.57 mm entrance clearance.
- Smaller upstream endcap apertures are proposed to preserve calorimeter filtering before muon coverage to eta 3.5.
- Compact forward alternative explicitly conflicts with existing muon stations.
- Documented experimentally grounded barrel/endcap service routes and depth limitations.

Sources include ATLAS/CMS detector papers, HGCAL TDR and later CMS calibration evidence. New-source metadata sent separately. Validation: 23 session records and whitespace checks passed; no simulation performed.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
